source_law_text: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway, unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].

axes.feasibility_evidence: NativeAdapter applies a source-gated walker control every original frame; local CPU tests exercise the three requests, while physical realization remains pending.

measurement.method: original 20 Hz pedestrian body velocity readback after departure, retaining the complete raw stream
measurement.time_window: original seconds 6 through 12 after departure, excluding startup transient

axes.range_rationale: Three authored walking controller requests for the existing 45-second route and source-gated Native walker; no value defines legal permission.
axes.spacing_rationale: Three separated physical setpoints permit measured approach variation while maintaining the same signal, route and cameras.

judgment_refs.note: WALK display is observed but permission under NRS 484B.283 requires independent source review.
judgment_refs.phrase: unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
